routing.staging: configured in the external alerting provider during Phase 25B
routing.production: configured in the external alerting provider after staging rehearsal

alerts.description: API 5xx rate or health-check failures exceed the approved threshold.
alerts.source: Sentry API project and container host metrics

alerts.description: Verification queue depth remains above the approved per-depth threshold.
alerts.signal: verification.quick, verification.standard, and verification.deep queue length
alerts.source: Redis queue metrics and worker MetricPoint queue_length

alerts.description: Verification run duration exceeds the approved threshold for its research depth.
alerts.source: Redis metrics stream and worker logs

alerts.description: DeepSeek or Brave provider failures exceed the approved retry-adjusted threshold.
alerts.signal: PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, provider errors, DeepSeek request failures, and search failures
alerts.source: worker Sentry project and durable run failure codes

alerts.description: Source extraction or unsupported-content failure rate exceeds the approved threshold.
alerts.source: worker MetricPoint values and durable source snapshot statuses

alerts.description: Accepted evidence per fetched source drops below the approved threshold.
alerts.source: Redis metrics stream and durable evidence counts

alerts.description: Citation audit failures or revision exhaustion exceed the approved threshold.
alerts.source: worker MetricPoint values and durable report citation audit statuses

alerts.description: Aggregate provider/search cost per verification exceeds the approved threshold.
alerts.signal: cost_per_verification, deepseek token usage, and search request count

alerts.description: Authentication, authorization, SSRF, upload, signed-download, secret-scan, or bucket-policy events require review.
alerts.signal: security middleware events, object-storage policy failures, Sentry security issues, and CI security gate failures
alerts.source: API Sentry project, CI security scans, and host security logs
